title: the coast road Rising
author: E. M. Blackwood
blurb: Beatrix Pemberton, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the demolition date arrives.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
